source.text: Patients with concomitant leptomeningeal metastasis are eligible provided they have parenchymal brain neoplastic disease requiring resection/biopsy

rejected.reason: quote does not appear in the criteria text
rejected.quote: Multiple primary malignancies within 3 years, with the exception of: adequately resected non-melanoma skin cancer; carcinoma in situ of the cervix; Smoldering pre-malignant or malignant conditions with minimal concern for CNS or extracranial progression during treatment such as CLL or MGUS based on the assessment of the treating provider; curatively treated in-situ disease; other solid tumors curatively treated; for patients with metastatic breast cancer: contralateral breast cancer
